title: WE ARE ALL WE HAVE

BUT IT'S ALL SO FUCKING BORING
YOU BETTER THINK ABOUT YOUR NECK

text:
DUVE Berlin is proud to present We Are All We Have, Jens Einhorn’s first solo exhibition at the gallery.

Jens Einhorn's new body of work, presented in Berlin for the first time, consists of a series of white, monochromatic paintings. Lengths of blue rope, subtly placed onto the surface of each of the canvases, act as a Leitfaden – a running thread – through which the works are simultaneously differentiated and tied together as a whole. Alternately evoking constraint and movement, they attempt to redefine and renavigate the space of the canvas, thereby mimicking the infinite possibilities of our own movement within space.

Einhorn brings a sense of urban destruction to his pared down paintings. While his previous work has used a variety of coloured pigments, in this series he developed a technique that relies more heavily on textural variation while revealing the visceral effort of bodily exertion. The titles reference lyrics ranging from 1990s punk bands to contemporary hip-hop and point toward a pivotal era of change, imagining another future far from all that had been known.
note: WE ARE ALL WE HAVE, 12 June – 17 July 2015, DUVE Berlin. Photos: Trevor Good.
